com.vector.cfg.dom.modemgt.groovy.bswm

Interface IBswMAutoConfigurationOverride


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IBswMAutoConfigurationOverride
    IBswMAutoConfigurationOverride is for deciding on what is to become of previously applied manual adaptations to the BswM auto configuration content on subsequent auto confugration runs.

    (c) Copyright Vector Informatik GmbH. All Rights Reserved.

    • Method Detail

      • discardOverride

        @PublishedMethod
void discardOverride()
        Call this if the corresponding manual adaptation is obsolete and shall be overwritten by the BswM auto configuration. Must only be called once.
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalStateException - if keepOverride() or discardOverride() has already been called

java.lang.Object getUserValue()

      • isAddition

boolean isAddition()

      • keepOverride

void keepOverride()
